dedupe_keys.name: ens larsim me monthly streamflow forecasts and reforecasts for the german waterways rhine elbe and danube

description: This dataset from the German Federal Institute of Hydrology (BfG) holds monthly streamflow forecasts and reforecasts for the German waterways Rhine, Elbe and Danube, produced in the EU IMPREX project to evaluate the skill of monthly flow forecasts and to support transport cost planning for inland navigation. The forecasts drive the LARSIM-ME hydrological model with ECMWF extended-range ensemble forecasts issued twice a week with lead times up to 46 days (a control and 50 perturbed members, at about 18 km resolution for 15 days and 36 km after), and reforecasts for the previous 20 years with 11 members. Coverage is regional, the German basins of the three waterways. The data are free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and available to download from Zenodo as two NetCDF files (version 1.0, March 2020), with the analysis in IMPREX deliverable 9.4 on a semi-operational forecasting system for the Rhine, Danube and Elbe. Caveats: it is a research dataset from a completed project, the non-commercial licence limits reuse, and the forecasts are discharges, not water depths at bottlenecks. It supports low-water risk analysis and climate adaptation of inland navigation, including cost and capacity planning for shippers. It complements the Danube FIS Portal water levels and is related to the Destatis inland waterway statistics.
name: ENS-LARSIM_ME monthly streamflow forecasts and reforecasts for the German waterways Rhine, Elbe and Danube

sources.note: IMPREX WP4 and WP9; deliverable 9.4; ECMWF-ENS extended range twice weekly to 46 days; resolutions; 51 members; reforecasts 20 years x 11 members; files Q_ENS_LME.nc and Q_SYNOP_LME.nc; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; v1.0 2020-03-10; BfG authors

title_en: ENS-LARSIM: ME monthly streamflow forecasts and reforecasts for the German waterways Rhine, Elbe and Danube
